sourceIdentity.identityMeaning: The exact recorded runtime snapshot is bound by the manifest and every observation; later workspace changes are not this scored revision.

method.calibrationLookup: Exact numeric tick match, otherwise linear interpolation using unchanged calibration range and plot.
method.endpointMetric: Euclidean error of each endpoint, plus individual coordinate and row errors.
method.ocrMetric: Numeric OCR readings associated to independently measured grid rows; glyph centres themselves are not asserted to be grid rows.
method.rawHintsEnumeration: Pinned unchanged pure collector/parser only; no image or production projection rerun.
method.omittedCandidateReason: Independent arithmetic reproduction of the recorded helper least-squares fit and exact containment guard.

limitations: These are five previously used development images; no held-out or broader scanner accuracy claim follows.
The emitted lines, plot edges and axis rows pass a geometric comparison only; support/resistance meaning remains unverified.
The two omitted exact top-boundary candidates are coverage defects. Their absence receives no geometric pass or verified-absence credit.
Both omitted prices are inside the independently read numeric domain; their global fitted rows fall just outside the measured plot.
d004 legacy pixels are non-null because its existing model-quality gate passed; its legacy axis remains held and its scored horizontal lines use IMAGE_AXIS.
d005 remains held because price text is approximate, not because support/resistance kinds are absent.
All prior failing or held observations remain historical evidence. This comparison does not authorize paid cases or deployment.
